implementation.versionRecord: This artifact is committed together with its implementation; code hashes identify the tested build independently of documentation and commit metadata.

measurement.queryMs: Edit plus hover request to hover response, including transport and queueing.
measurement.diagnosticMs: Same edit notification to current edited-file diagnostic publication; overlaps query time, do not add the two.
measurement.startupMs: New server process launch through initial hover response, including initialization, build selection and first document query. OS file cache and existing project parse artifacts can be warm.
measurement.continuousMs: Median of six body edits within each process, then median of three process medians. First edit is also reported separately.
measurement.memory: Darwin physical footprint; lifecyclePeakMiB is median of each process lifetime peak across all fifteen states, including manual rebuild. MiB=1048576 bytes. RSS and footprint are distinct; detailed states preserve both.
